application_type_full: Outline planning permission: Some matters reserved
description: Outline application for the re-development of the site (up to 10,000 sqm GEA) for light industrial (B1C) and/or general industrial (B2) and/or storage and distribution (B8) purposes together with ancillary office space, car parking and landscaping.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - Provided that a site-wide indicative masterplan  together with details of the first phase of the development, shall first be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority, the development may be carried out in phases.

Condition : 2 - Before commencement of each and every phase of the development, approval of the details of the layout, scale and appearance of the building(s), access and the landscaping of each phase of the development (hereinafter called "the reserved matters") shall be obtained from the local planning authority in writing.

Condition : 3 - Plans and particulars of the reserved matters referred to in condition 2 above, relating to the layout, siting and appearance of any buildings to be erected, access and the landscaping of the site, shall be submitted in writing to the local planning authority and shall be carried out for each phase as approved.
Condition : 4 - Application for approval of the reserved matters shall be made to the local planning authority before the expiration of (three) years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 5 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun either before the expiration of (three) years from the date of this permission, or before the expiration of (two) years from the date of approval of the last of the reserved matters to be approved, whichever is the later.

Condition : 6 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and in accordance with the following approved plans Drawing Numbers: 30061/PL/101B(Parameter Plan), 30061/PL/100A (Site Location Plan), submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 7 - No more than 10,000sq metres GEA of floor space to include ancillary office space, shall be included within the development hereby approved.

Condition : 8 - Prior to implementation of each and every phase of the development, there shall first be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority a plan indicating the positions, design, materials and type of boundary treatment for that phase of the development.   No phase of the development shall be implemented until the required details have been approved in writing by the local planning authority and each phase of the development shall be carried out and maintained in accordance with the approved details.  The boundary treatment shall be completed to the satisfaction of the local planning authority before the building(s) in that phase of the development are occupied or in accordance with a timetable agreed in writing with the local planning authority.
Condition : 9 - The processing, packaging and storage of commercial goods' activities  shall not take place anywhere on the site except within buildings

Condition : 10 - The office floorspace contained within the development hereby approved shall be used only as offices ancillary to the main use of the premises as B1c,B2 and B8 Uses  and shall not be used for any other purpose.
Condition : 11 - No fans, louvres, ducts or other external plant  shall be installed without the prior approval of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 12 - The use of each phase of the development hereby permitted shall not be begun until details of the arrangements for storing of waste and recycled materials (for that phase of the development to which they relate) have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.  The arrangements for storing waste and recycled materials shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with any approval given and shall be completed before any part of the development hereby permitted is occupied.

Condition : 13 - Before each phase of the development commences, details of facilities for the loading, unloading and turning of vehicles clear of the public highway for that phase of the development to which they relate shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.  The approved details shall be implemented and thereafter maintained unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 14 - Before each phase of the development hereby permitted is commenced a scheme indicating the provision to be made for disabled people to gain access into the development  for that phase of the development to which it relates shall have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.  The agreed scheme shall be implemented before each phase of the development hereby permitted is brought into use and thereafter maintained unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 15 - "Before the development hereby permitted commences:
a.The site shall be investigated by a competent person to identify the extent and nature of contamination. A detailed site investigation report shall be prepared and submitted to the LPA. The report should include a tiered risk assessment of the contamination based on the proposed end use of the site.  Additional investigation may be required where it is deemed necessary.

b. If required, a scheme for decontamination of the site shall be submitted to the LPA, for written approval.  The scheme must account for any comments made by the LPA     Before the development hereby permitted is first occupied:

c. The LPA shall be notified immediately if additional contamination is discovered during the course of the development. A competent person shall assess the additional contamination, and shall submit appropriate amendments to the scheme for decontamination in writing to the LPA for approval.  

d. The agreed scheme for decontamination, including amendments, must be fully implemented and a written validation (closure) report submitted to the LPA for approval."

Condition : 16 - During construction works an appropriate wheel-washing system shall be provided to remove mud, stones and any other extraneous materials from the wheels and chassis' of construction vehicles exiting the site and all loads of construction materials, excavation spoil or other such matter shall be fully covered in order to ensure that no material leaves the site attached to the vehicle which might subsequently be deposited on the highway. The exit from the wheel washing system shall be constructed from a hard, non-porous surfacing material and sited as far away from the exit to the highway as is possible given the constraints of the site and the surface shall be kept clean at all times.  Waste water discharged from the wheel washing system shall be stored and disposed of on site and shall not be discharged into the public sewerage system without prior removal of soil, stones and any other suspended material.  Suitable measures to minimise dust nuisance caused by the operations and to ensure that no dust or other debris is carried on to the adjoining properties shall also be provided and site lighting shall be designed, positioned and directed so as not to unnecessarily intrude on passing drivers on public highways and so as not to direct light into any windows of properties outside the site.  Start of works on site shall be notified to the Council's Community Environment Team on 020 8583 5070.
Condition : 17 - No soakaways shall be constructed in contaminated ground.

Condition : 18 - No phase of development shall be implemented until details have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority, for a scheme of achieving a minimum of 20% reduction in carbon emissions achieved by energy efficient methods together with a contribution from renewable LZC technology unless otherwise demonstrated  to the LPA that  this is not  feasible.  The details are to be based on an energy strategy required by London Plan Policy 4A.8 and shall be carried out as approved and retained for so long as the development shall exist except to the extent approved in writing by the local planning authority.

Condition : 19 - No phase of development shall be implemented until a statement on the sourcing of materials to be used in that phase of the development, involving reuse, recycling and other sustainable sourcing of materials to be used in the construction and fitting out of the building(s) within that phase of the development wherever possible has been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  These details shall be carried out as approved and thereafter maintained unless otherwise agreed in writing by the local planning authority.

Condition : 20 - No phase of development shall take place until details of measures for the harvesting of rainwater, the minimisation of water run-off from the building(s) within the phase of development to which it relates and the conservation and reuse as appropriate of other water supplies in the building(s) in the phase of development to which it relates have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.  These details shall be carried out as approved and thereafter maintained unless otherwise agreed in writing by the local planning authority.

Condition : 21 - A scheme of phasing of development shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority before development commences and the development shall be implemented in accordance with that scheme unless otherwise agreed in writing with the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 22 - Before each and every phase of the development commences details of parking for cars,  motorbikes and cycles (including spaces for people with disabilities) for that phase of the development shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority and the spaces shown on the approved drawing shall be laid out and available for use before first occupation of that phase of the development hereby permitted and shall thereafter be maintained and kept clear for that purpose in accordance with the approved details unless otherwise agreed in writing by the local planning authority.
